works.title: Commentary on the Apocalypse
works.subtitle: Fathers of the Church Patristic Series, Vol. 123
works.author: Andrew of Caesarea
works.publisher: The Catholic University of America Press
works.blurb: The earliest complete Greek patristic commentary on the Book of Revelation, Andrew of Caesarea reading St. John's Apocalypse within the consensus of the Eastern Fathers. Eugenia Scarvelis Constantinou's translation, the first into any modern language.
